podcast.title: Influence on Shoegaze
podcast.body: American rock, specifically aspects like those from Sonic Youth, contributed strong influences to the shoegaze sound, particularly its noisier, guitar-focused elements. "tenía como esas influencias muy fortes del garaje que podía ser de sonidjuz o de esa parte del roca americano."

srcs.episode: DREAM POP y SHOEGAZE. Diferencias entre ellos.

podcast.title: The Killers' Aspiration for Sam's Town
podcast.body: For their 2006 album "Sam's Town," The Killers, led by Brandon Flowers, consciously aimed to create "great American rock songs," drawing inspiration from Bruce Springsteen's style. "They really did want to make a Springsteen-type album featuring great American rock songs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
